data.action: 在钢架阴影中单膝蹲伏潜伏，单手扶夜视镜，恶魔双翼微微贴背收拢
data.camera: cowboy shot, high angle, stealth atmosphere
data.description: 【银镜伊织 · 暗夜要塞潜行突防】深夜重工业基地的高空钢梁结构上，红色的警戒探照灯在下方冰冷的管道间来回扫过。伊织身穿紧贴身形的黑色战术潜行衣，单膝蹲伏在阴影之中，指尖轻触夜视单目光镜，恶魔双翼微微收拢隐入夜色——「潜入成功，已绕过外部传感器。突击准备完毕，倒数三秒发起压制。」
data.lighting: 冷色月光与下方红色探照灯交错硬光
data.location: 要塞工厂高空重型钢架走廊
data.promptProse: Iori crouches on one knee on a high steel beam in the industrial base, touching her night-vision monocle while her small wings fold into the dark. Her reinforced black stealth suit and utility pouches remain visible in the high-angle cowboy view. Pipes and moving searchlights cross below. Cool moonlight defines the beam top and her shoulder, while red searchlight sweeps briefly reflect along the lower metal structure.
data.title: 银镜伊织 · 暗夜要塞潜行突防
